    function isApprovedForAll(address owner, address operator) external view returns (bool);

    /**
      * @dev Safely transfers `tokenId` token from `from` to `to`.
      *
      * Requirements:
      *
      * - `from` cannot be the zero address.
      * - `to` cannot be the zero address.
      * - `tokenId` token must exist and be owned by `from`.
      * - If the caller is not `from`, it must be approved to move this token by either {approve} or {setApprovalForAll}.
      * - If `to` refers to a smart contract, it must implement {IERC721Receiver-onERC721Received}, which is called upon a safe transfer.
      *
      * Emits a {Transfer} event.
      */
    function safeTransferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, bytes calldata data) external;
}

selectedFunctions.label: Elk Finance V3 exactInput
warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI inventory only: not persistent runtime attestation, live authorization, liquidity, backing, financial safety, execution success or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Only current official ElkDEX V3 SwapRouter on Polygon and Arbitrum is inventoried. Nonproxy root; implementation is the target itself. No ElkNet bridge, Bifrost, reservoir, executor, legacy token, discontinued farm or legacy-router capabilities.

Full deployment-specific Sourcify source/ABI retained for both targets. Creation/runtime grade is match, not exact_match; original bytecode transformations, immutable factory/WETH9 bindings and metadata remain in evidence. No generic Uniswap/fork ABI substitution.

User path bytes are fixed packed token-address/uint24-fee hops, not executable calldata: source derives pools from immutable ElkDEX factory0xc05a5aa56df0dc97d6b9849a06627a079790014f and fixed init-code hash; callback validates the derived pool. No arbitrary user target/callback activation.

Input/output amounts are integer token base units, native value wei, fees hundredths of a basis point and deadlines Unix seconds. Single-hop sqrtPriceLimitX96 uses Q64.96 square-root price; zero selects extreme default boundary. Pool math/rounding, fee tier, liquidity and token behavior remain external dependencies.

Payer is msg.sender for initial input, using existing token allowance unless the input is immutable wrapped-native token and sufficient router native balance is available. Intermediate exact-input hops use router custody. No approval or permit capability is granted. Fee-on-transfer/rebasing tokens are not accommodated by these methods.

All four methods are payable but do not automatically refund excess native input or unwrap wrapped-native output. refundETH, sweep, unwrap and multicall are excluded; use of native value, price limits or router/zero recipient can leave residual assets in publicly sweepable router custody. No complete native settlement workflow is promised. Choose and inspect recipient/value explicitly; zero recipient maps to router.

Exact-input swap sends specified token input through fixed ElkDEX pool interface, returns final amountOut and reverts unless amountOutMinimum is met; initial payer is msg.sender. Packed path is token/fee data only; exact-output path is reversed. Only derived pools can invoke swap callbacks; no executable bytes target. Deadline is enforced. No queue/claim or protocol permission grant is introduced.

Only current official ElkDEX V3 SwapRouter on Polygon and Arbitrum is inventoried. Nonproxy root; implementation is the target itself. No ElkNet bridge, Bifrost, reservoir, executor, legacy token, discontinued farm or legacy-router capabilities.

Full deployment-specific Sourcify source/ABI retained for both targets. Creation/runtime grade is match, not exact_match; original bytecode transformations, immutable factory/WETH9 bindings and metadata remain in evidence. No generic Uniswap/fork ABI substitution.

User path bytes are fixed packed token-address/uint24-fee hops, not executable calldata: source derives pools from immutable ElkDEX factory0xc05a5aa56df0dc97d6b9849a06627a079790014f and fixed init-code hash; callback validates the derived pool. No arbitrary user target/callback activation.

Input/output amounts are integer token base units, native value wei, fees hundredths of a basis point and deadlines Unix seconds. Single-hop sqrtPriceLimitX96 uses Q64.96 square-root price; zero selects extreme default boundary. Pool math/rounding, fee tier, liquidity and token behavior remain external dependencies.

Payer is msg.sender for initial input, using existing token allowance unless the input is immutable wrapped-native token and sufficient router native balance is available. Intermediate exact-input hops use router custody. No approval or permit capability is granted. Fee-on-transfer/rebasing tokens are not accommodated by these methods.

All four methods are payable but do not automatically refund excess native input or unwrap wrapped-native output. refundETH, sweep, unwrap and multicall are excluded; use of native value, price limits or router/zero recipient can leave residual assets in publicly sweepable router custody. No complete native settlement workflow is promised. Choose and inspect recipient/value explicitly; zero recipient maps to router.

Exact-input swap sends specified token input through fixed ElkDEX pool interface, returns final amountOut and reverts unless amountOutMinimum is met; initial payer is msg.sender. Packed path is token/fee data only; exact-output path is reversed. Only derived pools can invoke swap callbacks; no executable bytes target. Deadline is enforced. No queue/claim or protocol permission grant is introduced.
